excerpt: Wobo is an AI job-search agent that finds matching roles and applies with a resume and cover letter tailored to each. Free for 5 jobs a day; paid from $34.99.
content:
Wobo is an AI recruiter for job seekers. You upload your CV, answer a few questions and chat with it, and Wobo scans job listings every day for roles that match your experience. You can swipe through the matches yourself, with a match score, salary range and company ratings on each card, or let its Autopilot mode choose and apply for you. Each application gets a resume and cover letter tailored to the job, and a feature it calls Wobo Persona answers application questions in your own writing style rather than generic AI phrasing.

Wobo says it scans more than 50 sources and pre-vets every job to filter out ghost listings. It also offers free tools: an AI resume builder, a cover letter generator and an ATS resume checker that scores a resume against more than 24 criteria.

The free plan applies to 5 jobs a day. Unlimited ($34.99 a month) lets you swipe to apply without a daily cap, and Autopilot ($44.99 a month) finds and applies for you, with a 5-day free trial. The company says it is made in Brooklyn, New York. Its latest Product Hunt launch, on 15 June 2026, finished #2 for the day; the Wobo AI product page there has about 1,000 followers and two reviews.

Wobo - AI Job Search launched on Product Hunt on 15 June 2026 and finished #2 for the day, with 314 upvotes and 47 comments. It has 2 Product Hunt reviews averaging 5 out of 5 (as of 14 October 2026).

We have not tested Wobo ourselves. This page brings together its official site, pricing page and privacy policy, its Product Hunt page and the official pages of comparable tools, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.summary_short: AI job-search agent that finds matching roles and applies in your voice
use_cases: Applying to many matching jobs without filling in each form
Getting a resume and cover letter tailored to every application
Swiping through pre-vetted matches with salary and company ratings
Checking a resume against ATS criteria before applying
Keeping a job search running while you work or sleep

fit: are applying to a large number of roles and the forms take most of your time
want tailored resumes and cover letters without writing each one
want to choose jobs yourself but apply in one swipe
not_fit: apply to a handful of carefully chosen roles, where writing yourself may serve you better
are uncomfortable with an AI submitting applications in your name
look mainly for jobs in India: the examples on the site are US and global tech companies

pricing.intro: Wobo has a free plan and two monthly paid plans; quarterly billing is also offered at a discount. Prices are from wobo.ai, in US dollars.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: 5 jobs a day applied by Wobo, basic matching, AI-tailored resume and cover letters, basic Persona, 2 AI cover letters

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.detail: You choose the jobs and swipe to apply; unlimited applications, advanced matching, advanced voice Persona, unlimited cover letters, priority support

plans.name: Autopilot
plans.detail: Wobo finds and applies for you with deep AI matching; 5-day free trial

alternatives.intro: Other AI tools that help apply to jobs. Prices come from each product's own page, checked on 14 October 2026.

items.name: LazyApply
items.what: Browser tool that auto-applies to jobs on major job boards
items.difference: Priced per year with daily application caps; Wobo focuses on tailored resumes and answers in your voice.

items.name: Simplify
items.what: Free browser extension that autofills applications and tracks them
items.difference: Helps you fill forms faster but you still apply yourself; Wobo can apply for you.

pros: Free plan that still applies to 5 jobs a day
Tailored resume and cover letter for each application
Answers written in your style rather than generic AI text
Choice between swiping yourself and full Autopilot
cons: Autopilot sends applications in your name, so mistakes go out under it
Monthly prices are higher than some yearly-priced rivals
Job examples on the site lean towards US tech companies

x.none: We found no posts about Wobo's job search on X to link yet.

faq.a: An AI job-search agent. It scans job listings daily, matches them to your experience and applies with a tailored resume and cover letter, either after you swipe or fully on Autopilot.
Yes, the free plan applies to 5 jobs a day. Unlimited costs $34.99 a month and Autopilot $44.99 a month, with a 5-day free trial of Autopilot.

faq.q: How is Wobo different from other AI apply tools?
faq.a: Wobo says its Persona feature writes answers in your own voice, and that it pre-vets every listing to remove ghost jobs before they reach your feed.

faq.q: Does Wobo have free resume tools?
faq.a: Yes: an AI resume builder, an AI cover letter generator and an ATS resume checker that scores your resume against more than 24 criteria.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Wobo?
faq.a: LazyApply, which auto-applies on job boards from $99 a year, or Simplify, a free extension that autofills applications.
